$comment: Dated aliases of sf-message-log for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). remove(id) is read by the element itself: remove is Element.prototype.remove, and remove() without an argument must stay the browser's, so no shim row may wrap it (its row below is refused by the shim by design: mode component).

aliases.note: {before} becomes {direction: before, before}; one cancel for both names
remove(id) detaches and is noted; remove() is Element.remove()
